CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. Which response best shows understanding of The Fall of Man? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Fall of Man with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Fall of Man.
   C. Use The Fall of Man to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say The Fall of Man has no place in daily life.
